photos.desc: Muséum d'histoire naturelle Philadelphe Thomas : Carcharodontosaurus saharicus. Origine : Taouz (Maroc) n°inv 2017.1.1071
Preliminary skeletal silhouette reconstruction of Carcharodontosaurus saharicus with preserved bones (including tentative referrals) shown in gray (after Ibrahim et al. 2017). Scale bar equals 1 m.
Skull reconstruction of Carcharodontosaurus saharicus specimen SGM DIN 1, a giant carcharodontosaurid from the Cenomanian of North Africa. Known elements drawn after Sereno et al. (1996, Science 272:
5 giant carnivores: Tyrannosaurus rex , Giganotosaurus carolinii , Spinosaurus aegypticus , Carcharodontosaurus saharicus , and Mapusaurus roseae

Posterior skull elements of Carcharodontosaurus saharicus (UCRC PV12). Braincase in (A) ventral, (B) anteroventral view and (C) posterior view. Scale bar equals 10 cm. Abbreviations: f frontal fm fora
